prompts.illustration: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent illustration for the right side of a Chinese mini-program personal profile page. The attached approved UI mockup is the EDIT TARGET / subject and style reference. Extract and faithfully recreate ONLY the upper hero illustration: a friendly orange-and-cream watercolor kitten lounging curled on a folded cream woven blanket, its front paws crossed, chin low, large gentle open eyes, fluffy orange tail wrapping around its body; a sage ribbon tied at the blanket corner; a tilted ivory personal stationery card behind the kitten, with delicate green leaves and tiny white flowers, a little sage tape at the corner; a small airy botanical sprig above/right and a tiny brown outline heart. Keep the approved watercolor texture, kitten identity, proportions, resting pose and cream/sage palette. This is a compact GROUP illustration for a 190px-wide hero area, so stationery and sprig must stay close to the cat and be fully inside the canvas. Landscape composition approximately 6:5 with 5% clear padding, transparent background with genuine alpha. No UI, phone status bar, text, letters, avatars, menus, green wash background, floor or scene backdrop. Do not include an upright seated cat or a notebook. Preserve all edges of the blanket, tail and ribbon. This should feel like the same artwork from the approved mockup, not a different mascot.
prompts.wash: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: soft transparent watercolor wash background for a cream personal-profile page header. Use the attached approved mockup as STYLE REFERENCE for its upper hero background only. Create a horizontal wide watercolor texture approximately 2:1: extremely pale muted sage green and warm ivory pigment blooms on the far left and far right edges, translucent watercolor granulation, spacious nearly transparent center for readable native text, uneven organic feathered edges fading into full transparency along all four sides. True alpha transparency, not a white rectangle. Colors match #DDE4D7 sage and #F7F4EF cream; low contrast, calm, airy and elegant. No objects: no cat, foliage, flowers, stationery, ribbon, text, UI, hard outline, stripes, ruled paper, torn rectangular panel, postmark or stamp. Only the gentle mottled watercolor pigments from the reference, suitable to blend over a cream app canvas.
